cases.name: TransferMint Self-Transfer
cases.expected_issue: Self-transfer should not increase the sender balance, but sequential writes under aliasing mint value.
cases.functional_semantic: An ERC20-like token with minting and transfer logic. A self-transfer should conserve balance and not mint value implicitly.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02; FinanceFuzz; Verichains self-transfer exploit write-up

cases.name: TransferMint Self-Transfer Safe
cases.expected_issue: Self-transfer is explicitly handled as a no-op.
cases.functional_semantic: An ERC20-like token with minting and transfer logic. Self-transfer should preserve balance and is explicitly handled safely.

cases.name: Collateral Bound Misvalidation
cases.expected_issue: Borrow capacity should be derived from deposited collateral, not solely from the requested amount.
cases.functional_semantic: A lending contract where users deposit collateral and borrow against it. Debt must remain bounded by collateral times the collateral factor.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02 vulnerable lending logic example

cases.name: Collateral Bound Safe
cases.expected_issue: Borrowing is bounded by collateral and existing debt.
cases.functional_semantic: A lending contract where borrow capacity is correctly derived from deposited collateral and current debt.

cases.name: Double Claim Reward
cases.expected_issue: A reward entitlement should be consumed after claim and not payable multiple times.
cases.functional_semantic: A staking rewards contract where users accrue rewards and claim them. Each accrued reward amount should only be claimable once.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02 reward distribution guidance; Web3Bugs reward logic patterns

cases.name: Double Claim Reward Safe
cases.expected_issue: Claiming consumes the accrued reward.
cases.functional_semantic: A staking rewards contract where accrued rewards are zeroed after claim, preventing duplicate claims.

cases.name: Redeem Reuse
cases.expected_issue: A redeemable entitlement should not be reusable after redemption.
cases.functional_semantic: A coupon-like redemption contract where users redeem allocated credits. Redemption should consume the entitlement exactly once.

cases.name: Redeem Reuse Safe
cases.expected_issue: Redemption decreases remaining credits.
cases.functional_semantic: A coupon-like redemption contract where credits are deducted on redemption, preventing reuse.

cases.name: Finalize Without Commit Phase
cases.expected_issue: Finalization should only occur after the commit or bidding phase is validly completed.
cases.functional_semantic: An auction-like workflow with bid placement and finalization. Finalize should only be callable after the required phase has completed.

cases.name: Finalize Without Commit Phase Safe
cases.expected_issue: Finalization requires at least one bid.
cases.functional_semantic: An auction-like workflow where finalization is only allowed after a valid bidding phase with at least one bid.

cases.name: Round-Trip Share Inflation
cases.expected_issue: A no-yield deposit-withdraw round trip should not create net profit.
cases.functional_semantic: A vault-like contract that mints shares on deposit and burns them on withdrawal. A user should not profit from a zero-yield round trip.
cases.source_reference: FinanceFuzz invariant/equivalence motivation; OWASP SC02 vault accounting

cases.name: Round-Trip Share Inflation Safe
cases.expected_issue: A round trip is economically neutral in the no-yield case.
cases.functional_semantic: A vault-like contract where share minting equals deposited assets, making a zero-yield round trip neutral.

cases.name: Split Deposit Bonus Amplification
cases.expected_issue: Splitting one deposit into many deposits should not produce a more favorable economic outcome than a single equivalent deposit.
cases.functional_semantic: A vault with deposit bonuses. Economically equivalent split and merged deposits should not produce different total rewards.

cases.name: Split Deposit Bonus Amplification Safe
cases.expected_issue: The bonus policy is sequence-consistent across equivalent deposits.
cases.functional_semantic: A vault with a bonus policy that does not reward deposit splitting over an equivalent merged deposit.

cases.name: Healthy Position Liquidation
cases.expected_issue: Only undercollateralized positions should be liquidatable.
cases.functional_semantic: A lending contract with collateral and debt. Liquidation must only be allowed when the position is below the required collateralization threshold.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02 flawed lending and liquidation logic

cases.name: Healthy Position Liquidation Safe
cases.expected_issue: Only undercollateralized positions may be liquidated.
cases.functional_semantic: A lending contract where liquidation is permitted only when debt exceeds the liquidation-adjusted collateral bound.

cases.name: Early Vesting Release
cases.expected_issue: Tokens should not be releasable before the vesting schedule matures.
cases.functional_semantic: A vesting contract where users unlock tokens over time. Release should only succeed after the vesting cliff or maturity is reached.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02 state and timing logic

cases.name: Early Vesting Release Safe
cases.expected_issue: Release is time-gated by releaseTime.
cases.functional_semantic: A vesting contract where release is only allowed after the configured releaseTime.

cases.name: Double Refund Claim
cases.expected_issue: A refundable balance should be consumed after one successful refund.
cases.functional_semantic: An escrow or sale contract where users deposit funds and later claim a refund. Each refundable balance should be claimable at most once.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02 one-time entitlement and refund logic

cases.name: Double Refund Claim Safe
cases.expected_issue: Refund claims consume refundable balance.
cases.functional_semantic: An escrow contract where refund eligibility is single-use because the deposit record is cleared after refund.

cases.name: Duplicate Voting
cases.expected_issue: A voter should not be able to cast multiple votes for the same proposal using the same voting weight.
cases.functional_semantic: A governance contract where token holders vote on proposals. Each voter should only be counted once per proposal.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02 DAO and governance logic

cases.name: Duplicate Voting Safe
cases.expected_issue: Each address votes at most once per proposal.
cases.functional_semantic: A governance contract that records whether a voter has already voted on a proposal and rejects duplicate votes.

cases.name: Bridge Nonce Reuse
cases.expected_issue: A bridge message or nonce should be consumed after one successful finalization.
cases.functional_semantic: A bridge finalization contract where approved messages mint value on the destination side. Each approved message must only be finalized once.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02 bridges and burn/mint asymmetry

cases.name: Bridge Nonce Reuse Safe
cases.expected_issue: Approved bridge messages are consumed on first finalization.
cases.functional_semantic: A bridge finalization contract that marks each approved message as consumed after first use.

cases.name: Stale Oracle Borrow
cases.expected_issue: Borrowing decisions should not rely on stale oracle data.
cases.functional_semantic: A borrowing contract that uses an oracle price to determine credit capacity. The oracle data should be fresh and bounded before it is trusted for lending decisions.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02 price oracle manipulation and stale state logic

cases.name: Stale Oracle Borrow Safe
cases.expected_issue: Borrowing rejects stale oracle state.
cases.functional_semantic: A borrowing contract that checks oracle freshness before using the price for collateralized lending decisions.

cases.name: Withdraw Without Lock Expiry
cases.expected_issue: Locked deposits should not be withdrawable before the lock period expires.
cases.functional_semantic: A locked staking contract where users deposit funds for a fixed lock duration. Withdrawal should only be allowed after the unlock time.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02 workflow and timing enforcement

cases.name: Withdraw Without Lock Expiry Safe
cases.expected_issue: Withdrawals are blocked until unlock time.
cases.functional_semantic: A locked staking contract where withdrawals are only possible after the lock duration has elapsed.

cases.name: Total Deposit Cap Bypass
cases.expected_issue: The total deposited amount should never exceed the protocol-wide cap.
cases.functional_semantic: A capped vault where deposits are bounded by a maximum total capacity. New deposits must be checked against the remaining protocol-wide headroom, not only against the incoming amount.
cases.source_reference: OWASP SC02 business rules and bounded resource enforcement

cases.name: Total Deposit Cap Bypass Safe
cases.expected_issue: Deposits are bounded by remaining headroom under the global cap.
cases.functional_semantic: A capped vault where total deposits plus the incoming deposit must remain below the cap.
